### FILE: migrate-to-boot3.sh
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Applies the Spring Boot 2.7 -> 3.x source migration to the real project files.
# Run from the project root:  bash migrate-to-boot3.sh && mvn -q test
set -euo pipefail

MAIN=src/main/java
TEST=src/test/java
FACTORIES=src/main/resources/META-INF/spring.factories

# 1. javax.* -> jakarta.* (main + test)
find "$MAIN" "$TEST" -name '*.java' -print0 | xargs -0 perl -pi -e '
  s/\bjavax\.persistence\./jakarta.persistence./g;
  s/\bjavax\.validation\./jakarta.validation./g;
  s/\bjavax\.annotation\./jakarta.annotation./g;
  s/\bjavax\.servlet\./jakarta.servlet./g;
'

# 2. JUnit 4 -> JUnit 5 (tests)
find "$TEST" -name '*.java' -print0 | xargs -0 perl -0pi -e '
  s/import\s+org\.junit\.Test;/import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;/g;
  s/import\s+org\.junit\.Before;/import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;/g;
  s/import\s+org\.junit\.After;/import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;/g;
  s/import\s+org\.junit\.BeforeClass;/import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll;/g;
  s/import\s+org\.junit\.AfterClass;/import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterAll;/g;
  s/import\s+org\.junit\.Ignore;/import org.junit.jupiter.api.Disabled;/g;
  s/import\s+static\s+org\.junit\.Assert\./import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions./g;
  s/import\s+org\.junit\.Assert;/import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions;/g;
  s/\bAssert\.(assert\w+|fail)\(/Assertions.$1(/g;
  s/\@Before\b(?!Each|All)/\@BeforeEach/g;
  s/\@After\b(?!Each|All)/\@AfterEach/g;
  s/\@BeforeClass\b/\@BeforeAll/g;
  s/\@AfterClass\b/\@AfterAll/g;
  s/\@Ignore\b/\@Disabled/g;
  # Runners: SpringRunner is unnecessary (@SpringBootTest/@WebMvcTest/@DataJpaTest include the extension)
  s/^\s*\@RunWith\(SpringRunner\.class\)\s*\n//mg;
  s/^\s*\@RunWith\(SpringJUnit4ClassRunner\.class\)\s*\n//mg;
  s/^import\s+org\.springframework\.test\.context\.junit4\.\w+;\s*\n//mg;
  # Mockito runner -> extension
  s/\@RunWith\(MockitoJUnitRunner(?:\.\w+)?\.class\)/\@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)/g;
  s/import\s+org\.mockito\.junit\.MockitoJUnitRunner;/import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;\nimport org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;/g;
  s/^import\s+org\.junit\.runner\.RunWith;\s*\n//mg;
'

# 3. spring.factories: preserve auto-configuration registrations, then delete
if [ -f "$FACTORIES" ]; then
  if grep -q 'EnableAutoConfiguration' "$FACTORIES"; then
    mkdir -p src/main/resources/META-INF/spring
    perl -0ne '
      if (/org\.springframework\.boot\.autoconfigure\.EnableAutoConfiguration\s*=\s*((?:[^\n]*\\\n)*[^\n]*)/) {
        my $v = $1; $v =~ s/\\\n//g; print join("\n", grep { length } map { s/^\s+|\s+$//gr } split /,/, $v), "\n";
      }' "$FACTORIES" > src/main/resources/META-INF/spring/org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.AutoConfiguration.imports
    echo "Moved EnableAutoConfiguration entries to META-INF/spring/...AutoConfiguration.imports"
  fi
  if grep -v 'EnableAutoConfiguration' "$FACTORIES" | grep -q '='; then
    echo "WARNING: spring.factories has non-auto-config entries (listeners/post-processors); review before deletion:"
    cat "$FACTORIES"
  fi
  rm -f "$FACTORIES"
fi

# 4. Report constructs that need manual review
echo "---- Manual review needed (if any listed) ----"
grep -rnE '@Test\(\s*(expected|timeout)' "$TEST" || true                       # -> assertThrows / assertTimeout
grep -rnE 'assert\w*\(\s*"[^"]*"\s*,' "$TEST" || true                           # JUnit4 message-first -> message-last in JUnit5
grep -rnE '@Rule|@ClassRule|ExpectedException|org\.junit\.(Assume|rules)' "$TEST" || true
grep -rnE 'setUseTrailingSlashMatch|WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter|antMatchers' "$MAIN" || true  # Boot 3 / Spring 6 changes
grep -rnE '\bjavax\.(persistence|validation|annotation|servlet)\b' "$MAIN" "$TEST" || true
echo "Done. Now run: mvn -q compile && mvn -q test"
```
